blocks.tamil_translation: fasting, Salah and charity?” the Prophet ﷺ asked. The Sahabah (RA) said, “Please do tell us.” “Bringing about unity among people is the best of all these, because being without unity is something that shaves off the Deen (religion).” (Just as a razor shaves off the hair of the head completely, quarrelling among themselves will destroy the Deen.)” Hazrat Abu Darda (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمنِ عَنْ اُمِّهِ ﵂ اَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: لَمْ يَكْذِبْ مَنْ نَمَي بَيْنَ اِثْنَيْنِ لِيُصْلِحَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد في اصلاح ذات البين، رقم:٤٩٢٠
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever conveys (made-up words) in order to make peace between two parties, what he said is not a lie” (he does not incur the sin of lying). Hazrat Humaid ibn Abdur Rahman narrates through his mother (RA) that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ اَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُوْلُ: وَالَّّذِيْ نَفْسِيْ بِيَدِهِ مَا تَوَادَّ اثْنَانِ فَيُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَهُمَا اِلَّا بِذَنْبٍ يُحْدِثُهُ اَحَدُهُمَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو طرف من الحديث) رواه احمد واسناده حسن، مجمع الزوائد: ٨ /٣٣٦
blocks.tamil_translation: “By Him in Whose hand is my life! When two Muslims who loved each other become separated, there can be no reason for it other than a sin committed by one of the two.” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ used to say this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ اَيُّوْبَ اْلاَنْصَارِيِّ ﵁ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: لَا يَحِلُّ لِمُسْلِمٍ اَنْ يَهْجُرَ اَخَاهُ فَوْقَ ثَلَاثِ لَيَالٍ، يَلْتَقِيَانِ فَيُعْرِضُ هذَا
